caption: One unit, weights w₁ = w₂ = 1 and bias 0; only the threshold changes. At θ = 2 the net input reaches 2 only for (1,1), giving AND; at θ = 1 any pair with a 1 reaches 1, giving OR.

spec.title: AND and OR from one unit: w₁ = w₂ = 1, b = 0
spec.aria: A table of the four input pairs 00, 01, 10 and 11 with net input z = x₁ + x₂ equal to 0, 1, 1 and 2; the output is 0, 0, 0, 1 when the threshold is 2 (AND) and 0, 1, 1, 1 when the threshold is 1 (OR).
